notes.title: NEW DRIVING MECHANIC!
notes.content:
Discover the added tension of staying focused behind the wheel while chatting with your passengers. Avoid straying from your route, or you'll waste more time and gas. And you don't want to risk getting fired, do you? That would lead you to a new bad ending, which is added to the available endings in the game.

We're activating a new breakdown alert feature to notify you when you need to take the car to the shop.

We've also corrected some typos and made interface improvements, especially to the car's interior look.

notes.title: Leaves Early Access on Steam Today!
notes.content:
[b]REARVIEW MIRROR[/b] is a story-driven game set in a car where Salvatore Marino, an ex-convict, embarks on a journey through a corrupt world, confronting the consequences of his past while trying to rebuild his life and repair family relationships. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809935/6c0fe1977291398444866835114ef9ce450c1d79.png[/img]

However, his only job option pulls him back into the [b]criminal underworld[/b], where dangerous passengers and a mysterious woman test his resolve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809935/fe31491fc06f80fe5133ed7300d6f7c6f1adc46c.png[/img]

As Marino navigates this hostile world, he must [b]resist temptation[/b] and avoid falling back into crime. Players guide him through choices that determine whether his journey leads to redemption or a descent into darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809935/9e7eb0ef2b06e660b5f2e8f440d8dc7067a4fa65.png[/img]

Faced with limited options and looming threats, Marino must balance his desire for a fresh start with pressure from his former associates. His passengers represent danger, and the [b]mysterious woman[/b] lures him deeper into the underworld, pushing him to the brink.

After an initial phase in early access, the development team has implemented significant improvements:

[list]
[*] Full story, divided into twelve chapters and three acts.
[*] New characters to interact with.
[*] Multiple available endings.
[*] Improved game interface and morality system.
[*] Texts in Spanish, Catalan, and English.
[*] Voice acting in Spanish, Catalan, performed by professional actors and actresses.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809935/9e7eb0ef2b06e660b5f2e8f440d8dc7067a4fa65.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809935/6c0fe1977291398444866835114ef9ce450c1d79.png[/img]

notes.title: REARVIEW MIRROR MAJOR UPDATE ON OCTOBER 10th
notes.content:
Hello Thrill-seekers!

REARVIEW MIRROR is set to receive a major update on October 10th, introducing several new features to enhance your gameplay experience.

The new update will feature 12 chapters in total —now it contains 3 only. Apart from that, it will contain a lot of new characters, improved mechanics about morality decisions, and different endings. 

The update will also include a new UI/UX and a new soundtrack. Texts will be localized in English, Spanish, and Catalan, while voice acting will be performed in Spanish and Catalan.

Share your feedback with us, and follow us on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Cheers!

CUBUS GAMES TEAM
